title: COMP-1 — IBM single-precision floating point (NOT IEEE on legacy mainframes)
sourceContent:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. INTEREST-CALC.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
      *> COMP-1 = single-precision float (4 bytes). On IBM
      *> z/OS mainframes the historical format is HEX FLOAT
      *> (HFP) -- NOT IEEE 754. Migrating to Java float silently
      *> rounds the low bits differently. Modern mainframes can
      *> be configured for IEEE; whether THIS program ran in HFP
      *> or IEEE mode is an open question.
       01  WS-RATE    USAGE COMP-1.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           STOP RUN.
notes: IBM HFP vs IEEE-754 is a one-bit difference at the format level but a 7th-decimal difference in computed results. Surface this for any program migrated FROM an IBM mainframe FROM the 1970s-1990s.
